digest.component_or_area: store git operations classification and retry
propositions: Five git failure classification sites use different verdicts for identical error strings, creating inconsistent retry behavior across local, push, and CAS operations
Synthetic rc-124 timeout results are constructed at four separate sites with non-uniform retry policies, leaving sync._union_merge and push_recovery unprotected from transient FS errors

A single classify(result, *, operation) registry keyed by operation type consolidates all verdicts into ten kinds, with cannot lock ref preserving three distinct bug-hardened verdicts per operation context
The timeout construction is unified in gitutil.run_git_bounded while marker strings are centralized in git_outcome.py, with AST-based guards preventing marker string and timeout construction escape
sync._union_merge and push_recovery._merge_with_transport_retry gain transient FS retry protection through the shared classify registry without modifying existing control flow
